newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain budget deficit nat acct just over 1 pct/GDP.
newsitem.headline: Spain budget deficit nat acct just over 1 pct/GDP.

text.p: Spain's accumulated budget deficit to May on a national account basis, the accounting method relevant for the Maastricht criteria, was just above one percent of gross domestic product, Budget Secretary Jose Folgado said on Tuesday.

"In provisional terms on a national account it (the budget deficit) was slightly above one percent (of GDP) which means a fall of more than 30 percent over the same period of the year before," Folgado said.
The budget deficit on a national account basis, which is always given on an accumulated basis, was 0.7 percent of gross domestic product in April.
